item.title: The Feast of the Annunciation | OCN
item.description: God created us out of love. His love didn’t stop with the Fall. Out of His love for us, He provided a way for us to establish once again the communion we enjoyed with Him before the fall. He would incarnate His only-begotten Son, who would enter the world and share in our human nature. The Incarnation (Christmas) is the feast that commemorates the entrance of the Word of God into the world as a human being, as a baby.
